title: Prepending one computation step
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine, $F$ a set of states, and $P$ a predicate on work-tape head positions. Suppose one step of $M$ from $a$ reaches $a_1$, the state of $a$ is outside $F$, $P$ holds at the work-tape head-position vector of $a$, and there is a segment from $a_1$ to $b$ of length $t$ relative to $F$ and $P$. Then there is a segment from $a$ to $b$ of length $1+t$ relative to $F$ and $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ holds at the work-tape head-position vector of $a$
